T1 (plan section 9 ruling 4): in the T arm exemplars REPLACE supplied items, they do not add to them (supply bound = A's bound minus 8 plus an exemplar block of at most 2,000 tokens; the rule bank is Solver instruction text of at most 400 tokens); A keeps its bound and no bank. A declared T-vs-A protocol difference, not a confound.
T2 (plan section 4 and section 11 ruling 2): iteration-1 trajectories differ in decoding only (no bank exists yet); from iteration 2 the rule-variants mode applies.

T3 (plan section 9 ruling 3 and section 11 ruling 1): the construction column R01C is sampled over two interleaved halves; the bank a half consumes in iteration t+1 is distilled from the OTHER half's positives; the Fold B flight consumes the union.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure; at most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id; run-cumulative budgets.

findings.finding: The construction program is the Solver node's decoding column group s1..s4 + the twin aa + the delivering lock LAST (phase-native-module-v1-c7, 1 Perception + 6 Solver contacts per row), compiled by the real module compiler. It is chosen over the Perception-level sampling column because the sampler, the trace writer and the credit tooling key scores and delivered contacts by arm label s1..s4, which a sampling column (arms of draws) does not give. The alternative (n = 5, c10) is implemented as an option (tfrl_v2_port_derive_cells.construction_block) and tested, not registered.
findings.remedy: none; the owner confirms or redirects (O-construction-group).

findings.finding: The plan's iteration-1 trajectories differ by decoding seed only; the Solver decoding group refuses a seed override and two equal overrides, so s1..s4 share the lock seed and differ in top_p (0.80 / 0.90 / 0.95 / 1.00) at temperature 0.7, top_k 20.
findings.remedy: a per-arm seed offset in the Solver decoding group would restore seed-only (rails_pending).

findings.finding: saea-commit-vote-v1 does not exist. The Fold B vote uses saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 (plurality over scenario_action, entity clusters kept at support >= 2). The sampling axis requires greedy_first, so n = 3 is one greedy contact plus two drawn at lock seed + offset.
findings.remedy: fix the entity rule and register the policy (O-commit-policy).

findings.finding: slurp_module_construction.check_cell accepts the r01c variant only for vectors under vectors/slurp-stage3-construction-r01c-v1/ and the historical R01C agreement pin, which the port names do not satisfy. The construction cells therefore pin the minus-r01 train-exemplars twins directly (the committed VAR-2 R01C precedent) and do not name construction_roster.
findings.remedy: generalise the adapter to the port prefix and agreement pin before the variant is named.

findings.finding: T's supply bound is A's bound minus 8 and both caps (2,000 + 400 tokens) are folded into the frame's base prompt tokens. Default: 47 items, 15,768 estimated tokens against a limit of 17,406 (fits). Budget switch 6,144 / 7,168: 43 items, 14,828 against 14,334 (does not fit); the largest fitting bound is 40. The writer refuses under the switch.

verify_declared_module refuses the committed L338 port flight, and it refuses the T cells for the same reason: the config loader (rails.native_episode_config) checks EVERY declared consumption_module block, and the T cells declare lock v2.2, whose compiled knowledge_stores carry the historical 268-B store pins while the port re-authored stores differ at ten leaves (docs/results/2026-10-30-badcase-verify-declared-module-l338-port.md). T never calls apply_to (it moves only the compiler's policy and role leaves, as the L338 port derive does), so the derive does not hide the clash from the loader.
findings.remedy: T's module lock switches to the port lock version v2.2-npu-port once that registry entry lands (lock plan 3.14, owner-run in a parallel stream); until then the T cells keep lock v2.2 and the loader refuses them, as it refuses the L338 port flight.

findings.finding: The FIT caps are rows x contacts x 1 counting endpoint (native_contact_required_cap, raw-audio arm), checked at import against the gate's own helper; the packet-arm factor of 4 is not used.
The twin aa is in the construction group so that per-row credit counts a positive or negative only where lock and aa agree (8.5 % of rows differ within one flight).

owner_items.item: Under the thinking-budget switch (6,144 / 7,168) the Solver prompt limit is 14,334 and T's bound of 43 items plus both caps estimates 14,828 tokens: it does NOT fit. The largest fitting T bound is 40 items. The owner / planner chooses the bound (40 items, a smaller cap, or a larger window) before the switch is used for T; the writer refuses until then. The default fragment fits (47 items, 15,768 of 17,406).

The construction program is the Solver decoding column group (c7): the plan's seed-only iteration-1 trajectories need a per-arm seed that the group refuses, so s1..s4 differ in top_p at temperature 0.7. The seed-true alternative is the Perception-level sampling column (c10), which the arm-keyed trace and credit tooling cannot label. Confirm the c7 form or fund the labelling change.

prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact in any cell here; Fold A is the confirmation cell of a separate package and is never a bank source.
No Fold A or Fold B row is ever a source of the exemplar or rule bank (the construction scope is R01C; forbidden rosters Fold A v2, Fold B v2, DEV-1000).
No Reviewer or Planner visit; no tool schema on any role; max_revisions 0; no reasoning text is delivered, scored or carried to another node.
The delivering lock arm is the L338 port lock, byte for byte; the twin and the replicate are request-identical copies of it.
Every sampled contact carries the lock's thinking fields (budget and cap of the active model fragment); a sampled contact's decoding override changes only the sampling keys.
No deployment value (instances, tensor-parallel size, sequences per instance, devices) is registered here; nothing is flown before PORT_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE is filled and the bound re-derived.
No benefit claim and no admission: claims_benefit is false; rows stay unconsumed; the loop never advances to iteration 2 or 3 without reading the previous one.
No flight before the coordinator countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt, every PENDING pin is produced and re-pinned and the cells are flipped.
